cases.prompt: I made a small browser game with Three.js where you run a ramen cart. Help me market it.
expect: Scans project for engine/build clues before asking
Asks at most 4 questions per message
Records unknowns as 'unknown' instead of inventing

cases.prompt: Tôi đang làm game trồng tiêu 3D góc nhìn thứ nhất ở Đắk Lắk, giúp tôi tìm người chơi.
expect: Asks for an 'X meets Y' comparison
Suggests platform-picker or hook-finder as next step

cases.prompt: My game is for everyone, it's a fun game.
expect: Explains in one line why a narrow audience spreads faster
Asks the user to pick one primary group
Does not accept 'everyone' as the audience
